title: Mark focus
description: An architectural monogram moves from a complete lockup to a precisely framed close-up.
useCase: Direct attention from an identity system to its defining shape.
reducedMotion: The framing change resolves immediately for keyboard and reduced-motion users.
limitations: Independent fictional identity artwork. A bounded 2D transform study, not a camera or arbitrary element focus manager.
look: Flat vermilion page with a heavy black stacked sans wordmark at left, a large black geometric monogram at right and a ruled text button.
motion: Clicking eases the monogram to centre with exponential smoothing while it scales to 3.9× and turns 45°; the wordmark fades and slides left, and clicking again reverses mid-flight.
adapt: `tick` eases `value` toward `target` at rate 7, and `draw` maps it to the mark's position, scale (2.9) and 45° rotation plus the wordmark fade. Replace the `mf-mark` SVG path and `mf-wordmark` text with your own identity.
